'''MPS''' was a manufacturing company that produced and sold the [[Bpr-99 fusion reactor/Legends|Bpr-99 fusion reactor]], which was utilized in the [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|RZ-1 A-wing interceptor]]. This same type of [[Power core/Legends|power core]] was also used in a wide variety of other [[Starship/Legends|starship]] classes and models.
